omm_stream.ContribResponse

Base class of the responses returned after a contribution to the server.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.omm_stream.ContribResponse.

Syntax

ContribResponse(message: dict)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
message dict Yes Message received from the server.

Properties

Property Description
ack_id Acknowledgement ID of the contribution, if present in the message.
debug Debug information from the message, empty if absent.
error Error text of the response.
is_success True if the contribution was successful.
nak_code Negative acknowledgement code from the message, empty if absent.
nak_message Negative acknowledgement text.
type Type of the response message.
